chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Wes Helvey's Cincinnati band and its members
summary: He played Friday and Saturday nights with Helvey's band and tries to recall its members, including Buddy Lee and Edgar Curran.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: All that time that you were working in the day and you were going to school, when did you get a chance to play?
I played Friday and Saturday night with Wes Helvey's band.
Who else was in that band with you? Do you remember any of the musicians in that band?
Buddy Lee.
What did he play?
Trumpet. Oh brother! He died. Edgar Courdnce ... Tenor sax player. And Elton Henry Jameson is working now where works. Sandy?
Where's that, 106th Street?
Yeah...
Working 'round an elevator... That's an apartment house, where Sandy Williams works.
Sandy Williams was another musician in Wes Helvey's band?
... I played trombone too and I played trombone in Fletcher Henderson's band, Samuel Williams.
How about Wes Helvey's band, along with Buddy Lee and you say Edgar Curran. Those are some of the musicians who played with you in Wes Helvey's band? How big was the band?
... I think about seven, (Vince) on piano.
Who was playing piano?
(Vince...) And Edgar Currans was in the band, I just mentioned.
Playing tenor saxophone. So there were like four musicians. What did Wes Helvey play, the band leader?
He played alto sax. He was the leader. That was his band.
So we have trumpet, tenor saxophone, alto saxophone, trombone -
Take it easy. Let me think; that's been a long time ago.
Yeah, 1924!
I'm trying to think of the drummer's name. I know
his first name was John.
You say his first name was Johnny, or China?
John, J-o-h-n, and sharp... When I left Cincinnati -
